    LAG(f.sales_date) OVER (PARTITION BY s.country_code ORDER BY f.sales_date) as prev_date,
    LEAD(f.sales_date) OVER (PARTITION BY s.country_code ORDER BY f.sales_date) as next_date
  FROM dim_holiday h
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.country_code = h.country_code
  LEFT JOIN fact_sales f ON f.sales_date = h.holiday_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY OR f.sales_date = h.holiday_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  WHERE h.holiday_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND h.holiday_date <= DATE '2026-12-31'
),
sales_around_holidays AS (
  SELECT
    h.holiday_date,
    h.holiday_name,
    h.country_code,
    f.sales_date,
    CASE
      WHEN f.sales_date = h.holiday_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 'Ünnep előtt'
      WHEN f.sales_date = h.holiday_date THEN 'Ünnep napja'
      WHEN f.sales_date = h.holiday_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 'Ünnep után'
    END as period,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) as net_sales_eur,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count
  FROM dim_holiday h
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.country_code = h.country_code
  JOIN fact_sales f ON f.sales_date IN (h.holiday_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY, h.holiday_date, h.holiday_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE h.holiday_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND h.holiday_date <= DATE '2026-12-31'
    AND NOT f.is_cancelled AND NOT s.is_test_store
  GROUP BY h.holiday_date, h.holiday_name, h.country_code, f.sales_date, period
)
SELECT
  holiday_date,
  holiday_name,
  country_code,
  sales_date,
  period,
  net_sales_eur,
  receipt_count
FROM sales_around_holidays
ORDER BY holiday_date, sales_date;
